Canonical skills, four-client packaging, archives, and clean-clone Codex installation have structural evidence.
A private release holdout with unrelated prompts has not been frozen and scored.
All collection and combined discovery footprints are within the conservative serialized limits.
Zero critical failures is not established across the full quality and holdout matrix. Ours strictly passed zero repetitions in both settlement families despite leading their aggregate criteria.
Post-edit oracle isolation works, but six smokes—including three behavior-rich multi-file cases—saturated across every native arm; discriminatory fixture evidence is not established.

Public routing clears paired thresholds. Ours leads the final batch-offset and both settlement families in aggregate, and quality-and-token dominates every skill competitor on the fresh manifest-close transfer. Those are repeated public cases with zero strict ours passes; lease/fencing still ties baseline. Aggregate behavioral superiority and confidence bounds remain unestablished.

Collection-level non-inferiority is not established. Fintech now has a strong fresh transfer lead over every skill competitor, but ours strictly passes zero settlement repetitions; Distributed Systems still includes the lease/fencing baseline tie, and the original fintech authorization loss remains preserved.

Ours beat baseline in all three manifest-close repetitions and narrowly led the settlement-correction aggregate, but the Engineering evidence is one public cell and Distributed Systems includes ties. No statistically positive cross-scenario paired behavioral improvement is established.

Ours quality-and-token dominates every skill competitor on the fresh manifest-close transfer and four on settlement correction. However cxuu-golang-skills dominated the authorization cell, ours used the most tokens in the first Distributed tie, and baseline dominates the frozen lease/fencing transfer while remaining far cheaper on Fintech cases. The global behavioral frontier is not established.
Development artifacts are traceable, but the complete release and holdout artifacts do not yet exist.
